title: This is ACTUALLY really cool
body: I found this by literally looking up “What is the best app for making my own games for free?”. This pulled up, and I went “Sure, I’ll try it… it’ll probably be too hard though. Or cost money.” But neither. The ONLY downside is that you ARE limited to only 3 free games before you need a subscription thingy. It’s sad, but I get it. How else would they get money? I think I’ll just delete games that I am done with after uploading it somewhere so I can always play it again if I want to, yet I would have room for more. This is pretty easy, though it will take a lot of tutorials to learn. The furthest I’ve gotten so far is creating my own pixel art characters for a platform game I’m working on, which is SO fun! I made an animation of a dinosaur bobbing up and down on her cute little legs! 😆 Anyways, I can’t be full in my review since I haven’t even hardly made a game yet, but I can’t be full say that so far this is really fun. P.S. There are games that you can play made by other people, and while some are cute and fun, some are bloody, gross, creepy… even just the fronts of them. I have been trying to resist the temptation to scroll through them since some have TERRIFYING covers. I just really don’t want that kind of stuff in my life, you know? So anyways, I try to protect myself from that, which makes it pretty sad that I can’t play the “okay” and cute ones. I really think you should get it and try it out, especially for 2D games… it’s really simple and fun, with no coding. If you’re looking for more 3D stuff… and with coding… I would look at Unity3D, I tried it out once and it was awesome, but I didn’t know how to code so I couldn’t do anything lol 😂. Wow, this is way longer than I wanted it to be, haha! Anyways, bye, Jesus loves you, and… have a wonderful day! :) EDIT: I think I got my info wrong.
